title: FactorIA material (*.material.json)
description: A custom material: a GLSL surface snippet the engine injects into its mesh shader, plus the typed parameters and textures the snippet reads. MeshRenderer.material names the file and MeshRenderer.materialParams overrides values per entity. `factoria validate` and the `shader.compile` command check this file and compile the snippet; `material.info` describes a material.

doc.description: What the material looks like and what it is for (shown by material.info).

shader.description: Project-relative path of the GLSL snippet that defines `void surface(in SurfaceInput i, inout Surface s)` and optionally `void vertex(inout VertexData v)`, e.g. "shaders/water.surface.glsl".

lighting.description: "pbr": the engine's Cook-Torrance lighting, fog and sky reflection. "unlit": the surface albedo is drawn as it is (plus emission and fog).

alphaMode.description: "opaque": alpha is ignored. "clip": fragments with alpha below the float param `alphaCutoff` (added automatically, default 0.5; declare it yourself to change default, range or doc) are discarded, in the shadow pass too. "blend": drawn with the blended meshes, far to near.

params.description: Parameters the snippet reads as global variables named like the key (at most 16, each padded to a vec4; laid out in alphabetical order). Names are GLSL identifiers that do not start with fa_ and are not GLSL keywords.

type.description: float, vec2, vec3, vec4, or color (a vec4 the editor shows as a color picker).

default.description: A number for float, an array of 2, 3 or 4 numbers for vec2, vec3, vec4 and color.

min.description: Smallest sensible value (the editor slider's start); also checked against the default.

max.description: Largest sensible value (the editor slider's end); also checked against the default.

doc.description: What the parameter does and its unit. Required: AIs read it through material.info.

textures.description: Textures the snippet samples in the fragment stage (at most 4). In GLSL: `texture(sampler2D(name, name_smp), uv)`. Same naming rules as params.

default.description: Project-relative texture used when an entity gives none.

sampler.description: Filtering and wrapping of the sampler.

doc.description: What the texture holds (channels, color space). Required.
